what_happened: Registered conjecture temporalBooleanIntoTMBase machine-refuted in a scratch file during research: NF (X-top -> G X-top) is TM-derivable at Base via NB+MF+MT but fails on the serial linear order Z (+)lex Q, over which the temporal cell is sound. Compiled with lake env lean, axioms propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound.

Planner type-checked the six candidate Lean Challenge Statements with lake env lean against the built BimodalLib before pinning them, so the pinned signatures are known to elaborate over the existing vocabulary.

Plan follows research in replacing the soundness/bridge/completeness method named in the task description and M22 done-when clause by a syntactic translation method; C14 pins only declarations under import FormalSystem, so indexed edge theorems are stated over an abstract sublanguage in FormalSystem and the within-forms live in BimodalLib unpinned.

Kalmar completeness inside a sublanguage went through without the decision gate: taking the assignment for a context to be membership in the context removes any consistency hypothesis, and a Prop-valued calculus with a subset-generalized deduction theorem makes every combinator a two-line derivation. 236 lines, compiled first try.
git-commit-scoped.sh dropped 'Tests/BimodalLibTest/README.md' from a commit pathspec: not contained in task #975's declared file_scope.

Phase 7 commit was refused by the pre-commit typst-sync gate: a new file under Tests/ moves tests-file-count and tests-line-count in typst/generated/status.typ. The plan anticipated this drift only for .lean files under FormalSystem/. Fixed by typst-sync-check.sh --fix and staging status.typ; the phase marker had already been set COMPLETED by the closing helper before the commit landed, and was committed green on the retry.

verify-touched.sh (no arguments), the scoped tier for Phase 9, selected 127 agent-system suites from the touched-path fallback set, ran about 22 minutes, and exited 1 on one suite, test-deploy-propagation.sh: deploy-headless.sh exits 3 in a scratch repo at 'runtime-file tracking policy reported failures'. check-runtime-file-tracking.sh passes when run in this repository. The suite reads no file this task changed; the touched set also contained a foreign uncommitted scripts/check-copyright-headers.sh, which widened the selection. Reported red in the summary and handoff, not waived.

Two README files this task needs are outside its declared file_scope and are dropped by git-commit-scoped.sh: BimodalLib/Conservativity/README.md (new; readme-lint reports a missing README for the new directory without it) and Tests/BimodalLibTest/README.md (rows for the two new test modules and the fixture). Both are edited in the working tree and left uncommitted.

A conjecture note that named a declaration as BimodalLib.Edges.discreteUniformity made check-module-invariants C5 fail on the generated BimodalLib/INDEX.md: C5 reads a dotted BimodalLib.X in markdown as a module path, and Edges is a namespace, not a module. Reworded the note to cite the file. Also: the harness moves any Bash call past 180 s to the background, so a 4-minute check-module-invariants run needs waits in slices under 180 s.
